description: Defines distributed data samplers for PyTorch, including classes for random and sequential sampling in distributed settings.

classes.name: DistributedSampler
classes.description: A template class for sampling subsets of data in distributed training, supporting configurable roundings and parameters.

classes.name: DistributedRandomSampler
classes.description: A class for randomly sampling data in a distributed setting with shuffling and reset capabilities.

classes.name: DistributedSequentialSampler
classes.description: A class for sequentially sampling data in a distributed setting with reset capabilities.

methods.name: set_epoch
methods.description: Sets the epoch number to alter sampling and shuffling behavior.

methods.name: local_sample_count
methods.description: Calculates the number of samples per replica, considering duplicates allowance.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the sampler to a new set of indices, optionally with a new size.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next batch of indices for sampling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes the sampler state to an archive.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserializes the sampler state from an archive.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the sampler.

methods.name: populate_indices
methods.description: Populates the internal indices vector for sampling.
